themes.what: Profile boxes are locked with no Edit on the return, and a blank profile value arrives locked too. One change in the shell fixes every form.
Opened from the Form library, the year, month, quarter or date arrive filled. One change in the shell fixes every form.
Schedules and tables sit inside the wrong part or are drawn as a single loose item ('Item Schedule 1', 'Part II row 1 ATC code').
The Details of Payment part (cash/bank debit memo, check, tax debit memo, others) has no part on the page, or its rows are all locked.
The page-2 header (TIN and name copied from Part I) is drawn as an item for the filer.
Printed items or schedule rows are hidden in a collapsed 'Additional details - N more fields not yet placed' group.
Labels are box keys or developer text ('Tax relief yes', 'MOP payment actual', 'Pg1I6Seller Addr', 'Special rate yn').
RDO Code missing from the page even though the print fills it from the profile, or drawn as two boxes.
Names, phone numbers, counts or rates drawn as peso amounts (e.g. contact number '280,000,000.00').
Penalties locked with no override, or a new return arriving with a penalty already filled (2551-Q: Compromise 1,000.00).
Civil status is not shown, so the married-only lines cannot be drawn as conditional.
In the worst-case print, page 1's TIN segments stay blank (only the branch code prints); 2550-M also repeats the whole RDO and ZIP in each box.
To check: the page shows 'Yes' and a treaty choice for the tax-relief item while the exported draft holds No and none.
